Democrats' DHS shutdown is wreaking havoc on our nation — & the consequences go beyond long TSA lines.

As chairman of @HomelandGOP's Special Events Task Force, I questioned witnesses today about the danger the shutdown poses ahead of the FIFA World Cup & America250 celebrations.

Tune in to today's @HomelandGOP hearing at 10am ET as we discuss the dangerous consequences of Democrats' DHS shutdown.

Congratulations, Secretary Mullin! A dedicated public servant and border security champion, he will lead DHS with excellence.

As the chair of the Special Events Task Force, I look forward to working with him and his team at DHS to protect our homeland from threats ahead of mass gatherings like America250 and the 2026 FIFA World Cup.


CSPAN (@cspan)

U.S Senate confirms Markwayne Mullin to be Secretary of Homeland Security, 54-45.

Chuck Norris was an American hero, both on and off the screen. A resident of Grimes County in my district, he embodied the Texan values that make our state great. His wife Gena, their loved ones, and the Brazos community are in my prayers as they grieve the loss of a titan.


House Republicans (@HouseGOP)

RIP Chuck Norris 🕊️

While the FIFA World Cup presents a unique opportunity to showcase American leadership and excellence, we must be clear-eyed about the threats facing our nation. As we’ve learned from past events, including the Boston Marathon bombing, those who seek to do us harm often exploit events of this magnitude as a backdrop for terror. These grants will actively work to thwart those evolving dangers in today's heightened threat environment.

I’m grateful to all those at @FEMA who pushed through Democrats’ DHS shutdown to get these vital security grants out the door — including more than $100 million for host cities in Texas. With less than 90 days to go until the opening match, I will continue working full speed ahead in Congress and alongside the White House task force to protect all players, spectators, and local communities.


FEMA (@fema)

Iran has posed a threat to the U.S. since 1979. Even as negotiations were ongoing, the regime was rebuilding its nuclear capabilities and missile stockpiles.

Unlike all of his predecessors, President Trump took action to put an end to that threat and protect our nation.

Video

Ever since the implosion of Afghanistan, the U.S. and our allies are facing a myriad of threats — from the Iranian regime, to Russia's war on Ukraine, to China’s aggression in the Indo-pacific.

At today's @HouseForeignGOP hearing, I spoke with @USDASDuffey about whether our weapons stockpiles are ready to meet the challenge of modern warfare.

Video

I’ve worked for years to fully fund the national security grant program, which provides resources to secure houses of faith — a pressing need amidst today’s heightened threat environment. 

I commend Temple Israel’s security officers, who took swift action to protect the community, as well as the law enforcement officers who remain at the scene. My prayers are with all those involved.

Grateful @NewsNation & @JoeKhalilTV are sharing Logan's story & honoring Mikaela's legacy. Kids like them are the reason I fought so hard to pass the Mikaela Naylon Give Kids A Chance Act, which will spur cutting-edge pediatric drug development for years to come. Watch this important story:

Video

The military objectives for Operation Epic Fury—dismantling Iran's missile & drone production, destroying their Navy to open the strait of Hormuz, & ensuring they never have a nuclear weapon—are achievable. I joined @CNN to discuss the military's success & what could come next.

Video

Having served as the lead congressional investigator for the Boston Marathon bombing, I know that what happened in New York could have been far, far worse. Today on @Newsnation, I discussed the @NYPD's heroic response and the heightened threat environment facing our nation.

Video

It was a tremendous honor to visit Dharamshala and personally tell the Dalai Lama and his people that the U.S. has not forgotten their plight. We will continue to firmly stand with Tibetans against the CCP's ongoing oppression until they can safely return to their homeland.
